$schema_note: Twitch hosts the canonical extension manifest inside the Developer Console — the upload .zip itself does not contain one. This file is the source of truth for what to enter into the Console so panel / video overlay / config asset paths, anchors, allowlisted fetch domains, and version metadata don't drift between submissions.
name: OCE Inhouse
summary: Show a Dota 2 streamer's OCE Inhouse rank, current W/L streak, and last 5 matches without leaving Twitch.
description: Read-only Twitch panel + video overlay for the OCE Inhouse community. Viewers see the broadcaster's current rank/tier, MMR, win/loss streak, and last 5 inhouse matches (hero, KDA, GPM, XPM, result). All data comes from public, unauthenticated endpoints on oceinhouse.gg — no Twitch OAuth, no secrets, no chat interaction.
viewer_summary: Shows the broadcaster's OCE Inhouse stats — read-only, polls every 30 seconds.

package_layout.config/: Broadcaster configuration page — paste the oceinhouse.gg account id.
package_layout.panel/: Panel surface (always visible under the player).
package_layout.video_overlay/: Optional video overlay — small live-presence chip top-right of the player.
package_layout.shared/: Vanilla-JS fetch helpers + CSS imported by all three HTML surfaces. MUST be included in the upload zip.
